thesis: Lightning Bolt defined the rate for red interaction because one mana can remove a creature, finish a planeswalker, or become the final three points to the opponent.

competitiveTimeline.significance: Its deck history stretches from early red-green aggression through Sligh, Burn, Zoo, Delver, and Modern red shells, making it one of the archive's broadest tournament narratives.

playbook.role: Preserve Bolt when the opponent's life total makes every copy part of a coherent clock; spend it early when tempo matters more than reach. Sequence around prowess, delirium, damage prevention, and the possibility that a creature will grow out of range.

counterplay.directAnswers: Increase toughness, force inefficient targets, and track the opponent's remaining burn. Lifegain is strongest when it changes the number of spells required rather than merely erasing one Bolt.
